*The evaluation aimed to inform decisions on scaling up, restructuring, and rationalizing the existing schemes. Assessment was carried out using the REESI+C+E framework along with causal analysis to examine the relationship between outcomes and impact. A brief snapshot is attached to provide an overview of the schemes and their performance of Urban and Skill sector.*
